domain: Numerical simulation methodology and statistical validation

row_dispositions.basis: The research distinguishes physical, model, receiver and capacity estimands and records absent target calibration/population as owner inputs.
Fresh generator-family, finite-filter/interpolation, AR/Jakes, trajectory/replay and observed noise alternatives have scoped error/cost comparisons.
Finite Gaussian and fractional-delay formula checks cover sampled covariance, phase, support, normalization and state limits; complete stream and profile-specific physical tail remain unexecuted.
Matched marginal/dwell, multicarrier covariance, source-dependence and time-history checks are performed; the natural target joint law requires calibrated synchronized captures.
Observed conditional extremes, event/outage, marginal-versus-joint limits and synthetic stresses are separated; no natural target occurrence law is claimed.
Episode, pairing, endpoint and censoring methods remain explicit; source comparator and companion observations preserve missingness and dependence limits.
Independent exact interval, AR(1), and multiplicity illustrations are correct and state their assumptions; no unprovided product target is selected.
No weighted rare-event or tail-prevalence estimator is claimed; constructed probabilities remain conditional illustrations.

A five-regime matched-control/holdout matrix and bounded pilot now complement actual published/source-observable comparators; calibrated target captures and product results remain outside the study and blocked on missing profile/calibration inputs.

Multiple independently checkable adverse/boundary counterexamples cover finite processes, interpolation, dependence, outages, same-power/same-flat-PSD noise tails, multiple looks and public field residuals.

Exact source/data provenance, retained failures, 20-record/40-replay count, source-composed tail and parametric sample/storage formula, active-only lower bound, cap and refusal conditions are supplied; actual totals are held until profile/tail/lane inputs exist; no runtime/hardware qualification is claimed.

performed_checks: Read and compared actual Gaussian helper headers with lead standalone probe and retained output; did not rebuild it.
Read source interpolation implementation and independent fractional-delay calculation/output; no pump source was built or run.
Reran research/hf-reference/reference_checks.py with python3 -I; successful exit and saved metrics reviewed.
Independently recalculated pilot duration, 48 kS/s sample and storage arithmetic, paired receiver input seconds, and run count.
not_performed: No pump build, complete channel simulation, production receiver run, calibrated field capture, hardware measurement or throughput benchmark.
No claim that D1 rows are independent holdout trials, target modem outcomes, or a natural availability denominator.

The bounded pilot remains conditional on the actual receiver profile, calibration/front-end inventory, maximum path/selective/interpolation/frontend tail, capture lead/trail, sample rate and lane count.
